column1: # Cartographer mount offsets for K1-series toolheads.
# SOURCE: fetched verbatim from pellcorp/creality  mounts/cartographer/*.overrides
#         (2026-07-27). These are physical mount geometry, so they carry over to
#         the 2025 X2600 boards unchanged — the toolhead did not change.
# DO NOT hand-edit these numbers. Wrong offsets put the nozzle in the wrong
# place relative to the probe and can drive it into the bed.
# CAVEAT: values assume the mount's standard probe variant and mount path.
# If you use the low-profile probe and/or an alternate mount path, verify by
# measuring nozzle-tip to coil-centre before trusting them.
# Reachability rule: nozzle_Y = mesh_Y - y_offset must stay <= stepper_y
# position_max. Verified on a 2025 K1C: SkeletorMK7 mesh_max Y=200 with
# y_offset=-22 needs nozzle Y=222; live position_max is 225. Clears by 3mm.
# SKELETOR — there are two styles, pick the right row:
#   SkeletorMK7         = BOTTOM mount path (standard / low-profile probe).
#                         Offset is in Y, probe sits in front of the nozzle.
#                         Offset is in X, probe sits beside the nozzle.
